title: The North Face Transgrancanaria — official home page and race cards
publisher: The North Face Transgrancanaria / Arista Eventos S.L.
claims: The home page header states that the 2027 event runs from 22 to 28 February 2027 and that registrations are open.
The home page race cards still describe the 2026 week: '4-8 March', VK Wednesday 4th, Half & Promo Thursday 5th, Marathon Friday 6th, Classic & Advanced Saturday 7th, alongside a 'Results 2026' link.
The Classic card gives 125 km, 6,764 m of positive gain, a 30-hour cut-off and a start on 'March 6, 11.59 PM'.
The Advanced card gives 81 km, 4,314 m and 21 hours; the Marathon card gives 46 km, 1,784 m and 11 hours.

The navigation menu labels the races Classic 126 km, Advanced 82 km, Marathon 47 km, Half 23 km, Open Agáldar 21 km, Promo 12 km, Short 5 km, Family Trail and VK El Gigante, while the page URLs still carry other distances (advanced-84km, marathon-46km, starter-21-km).

The remaining cards give Half 23 km with 1,817 m and 6:30, Open Agáldar 21 km with 613 m and 5:30, Promo 12 km with 869 m and 6:30, Short 5 km with 264 m and 1:30, Family Trail 5 km with 264 m and 1:30, and KV El Gigante 5.5 km with 1,090 m and 1:30.

The home page describes the Classic as part of the World Trail Majors circuit and the Marathon as part of The Short Series by Gran Canaria World Trail Majors; it does not describe the event as part of the UTMB World Series.
The home page navigation contains no transport, shuttle or travel page.
